visual.general_description: Image-only table of PSYRATS item, subscale and total scores before and after treatment.
visual.detailed_description: Image-only table with no printed table number, titled by section rows "PSYRATS—auditory hallucinations" and "PSYRATS—delusion"; each item row prints a pair of integers separated by a slash (for example frequency, duration, location, loudness, beliefs about voice origin, amount and degree of negative content, severity and intensity of distress, disruption, controllability for auditory hallucinations; frequency and duration of preoccupation, conviction, intensity of distress, amount of distressing content, disruption for delusion). Subscale and total rows print scores out of a maximum with the labels "(Before treatment)" and "(after treatment)": auditory hallucinations 32/48 and 16/48, delusion 22/24 and 15/24, total 54/72 and 31/72. Most item pairs have a smaller second integer; the disruption pair prints 1/2 and the controllability pair 2/3 (second integer larger), and the delusion frequency, duration and amount-of-content pairs print equal integers. The first item pair carries an asterisk; the footnote prints "Likert scale ranging from 0 (absent) to 4 (fully present)" and "PSYRATS = Psychotic Symptom Rating Scales" with a bracketed reference marker. The 11 auditory hallucination items have first integers adding to 32, matching the printed before-treatment subscale score, and second integers (3, 1, 1, 2, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 3) adding to 17, not the printed 16 after-treatment score; the printed maximum 48 is not 11 times 4 (44). The delusion integers match their printed subscale scores (22 and 15). No patient names, dates, institution names or device text are printed.
